suite: 3D pane follows the selection (sweep, bind, reload, hover)
expect_red: [real] a feature row is reached by the keyboard, and Enter selects its node

mutations.contract: A feature row is a button-role row: Enter and Space act as a click.
mutations.note: Enter no longer acts, so a keyboard reader can reach a feature and never select it.
mutations.find:
if (!event || (event.key !== "Enter" && event.key !== " ")) return;
      if (event.target !== row) return;
mutations.replace:
if (!event || event.key !== " ") return;
      if (event.target !== row) return;
